relations.subject: Laurie L. Patton
relations.evidence: Laurie L. Patton (born November 14, 1961) is an American academic, author, poet and professor of Asian religion who is President of the American Academy of Arts & Sciences.

relations.subject: Laurie L. Patton
relations.evidence: She served as President of Middlebury College from 2015 to 2024.

relations.subject: Laurie L. Patton
relations.evidence: She earned a Bachelor of Arts degree from Harvard University in 1983

relations.subject: Laurie L. Patton
relations.evidence: and her PhD from the University of Chicago in 1991.

relations.subject: Laurie L. Patton
relations.evidence: She was a Fulbright Scholar at Tel Aviv University in Israel in 1999

relations.subject: Laurie L. Patton
relations.evidence: and at Deccan College in India in 2000.
